answer: Here’s how escrowed rewards foil Sybils. First, agents deposit stake into a vault. They’re rewarded in escrow. Second, peers inspect them in a challenge window, like checking an orchard for rot. Third, rewards release only after this window. Each fake agent needs a separate garden of alleys to confirm peers, forcing attackers to plant physical timers. Each identity needs 30 RealWorld stale clicks—no bulk buy.
